master.definition_en: A malignant germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of a monotonous primitive germ cell population. The neoplastic cells form aggregates and have an abundant pale cytoplasm and uniform nuclei. The aggregates of the germ cells are separated by fibrous septa which contain inflammatory cells, mostly T-lymphocytes. It arises primarily in the ovaries, but can occur both primarily and secondarily at other sites, particularly the central nervous system. It responds to chemotherapy and radiotherapy. Its prognosis is related to the tumor stage.

top_drugs.drug_name: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS, L1 PROTEIN VIRUS LIKE PARTICLES

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 罕见妇科恶性肿瘤
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 约90%为鳞状细胞癌，常在长期外阴硬化性苔藓(VLS)或高危HPV16/18感染基础上缓慢演变而来；因部位隐私及患者羞于就医，常被误当“外阴湿疹/瘙痒”拖延至腹股沟淋巴结肿大破溃才就诊；晚期腹股沟转移瘤侵蚀股动静脉可突发致命性大出血。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期（Ⅰ期且腹股沟淋巴结阴性）经根治性局部广泛切除联合前哨淋巴结活检，5年生存率高达85%–90%；一旦发生腹股沟淋巴结转移，5年生存率降至50%–60%，广泛远处转移者5年生存率约15%–25%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 2022年全球约1.89万例死亡，主要见于绝经后老年女性及HPV持续感染人群

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 2022年中国约1,956例死亡，占全部妇科恶性肿瘤死亡比例较小但农村及老年女性延误就诊率高

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 2022年全球新发约48,894例，分为HPV相关性（约30%–40%，年轻化）与HPV非相关性/TP53突变型（约60%–70%，关联外阴硬化性苔藓，GLOBOCAN 2022 / ORPHA:494418）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 2022年中国新发约4,117例，多见于60岁以上绝经后女性

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 腹股沟转移性淋巴结破溃侵蚀股动脉/股静脉致喷射性大出血：立即用无菌敷料持续用力指压腹股沟韧带下方股动脉搏动点止血（切忌松手），120急诊送院行血管覆膜支架植入或外科血管修补/结扎; 2) 外阴巨大坏死性肿瘤伴重度盆腔/腹股沟脓毒症：立即静脉广谱抗感染及创面清创引流。

standard_drugs.drug_class: 铂类同步放化疗增敏及晚期联合化疗
standard_drugs.usage_role: 局部晚期不可切除同步放化疗及复发转移一线化疗
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 顺铂、紫杉醇、卡铂均为国家集采药物，单周期药费约400–1,200元
standard_drugs.cost_source: 国家组织药品集中采购中选结果

standard_drugs.name_zh: 帕博利珠单抗 / 纳武利尤单抗
standard_drugs.usage_role: PD-L1阳性或MSI-H/TMB-H复发转移性外阴癌后线/一线联合免疫（CheckMate 358及KEYNOTE-158亚组有效）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国内尚未单列外阴癌适应症常规目录覆盖，多参照头颈/宫颈鳞癌自费或临床试验入组

non_drug_therapies_zh: 早期单灶肿瘤(<4cm)优先采用‘外阴广泛局部切除+前哨淋巴结活检(SLNB)’替代传统广泛根治+双侧腹股沟淋巴结清扫，大幅减少下肢淋巴水肿与切口裂开并发症
对长期外阴瘙痒、白斑、溃疡经久不愈者尽早行多点病理活检（排查外阴上皮内瘤变VIN及分化型dVIN）
适龄女性接种HPV九价/四价疫苗可有效预防HPV相关外阴癌及癌前病变
外阴硬化性苔藓患者长期规范外用超强效激素软膏(氯倍他索)控制慢性炎症可显著降低癌变风险
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 早期局部切除及前哨活检全程约2万–4万元；局部晚期同步放化疗及皮瓣修复约6万–12万元

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) GROINSS-V II与GROINSS-V III国际研究验证前哨淋巴结微转移(<2mm)患者可用精准放疗替代腹股沟淋巴结清扫，彻底消除80%以上的慢性下肢象皮肿; 2) 2024年WHO分子分层明确HPV阴性但p53异常型外阴癌复发风险显著高于HPV阳性型，推动新辅助放化疗联合PD-1免疫试验(如KEYNOTE-A18思路外推); 3) 靶向TROP2及Nectin-4的ADC药物在复发外阴鳞癌开展篮子试验。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 老年女性因隐私顾忌延误就诊，初诊即伴巨大溃烂及腹股沟固定淋巴结转移比例高; 2) 腹股沟区放化疗及手术后伤口极易感染裂开及顽固性下肢淋巴水肿; 3) 缺乏专为外阴癌设计的大型3期靶向/免疫随机对照临床试验。

master.definition_en: Colloid cysts of the third ventricle are non-cancerous brain lesions. The third ventricle is a cavity in the brain that is filled with cerebral spinal fluid (CSF). Colloid cysts can cause blockages resulting in a build up of CSF in the brain (hydrocephalus) and increased pressure. Some colloid cysts are asymptomatic while others cause neurological symptoms, such as headaches, swelling of the optic nerve (papilledema), and drop attacks. When symptoms are present onset tends to be in the third to sixth decade of life. While uncommon, symptoms of colloid cyst can become life threatening.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

Afibrinogenemia (complete absence of fibrinogen) and hypofibrinogenemia (reduced plasma fibrinogen concentration) correspond to quantitative anomalies of fibrinogen while dysfibrinogenemia corresponds to a functional anomaly of fibrinogen. master.definition_en: Cor triatriatum sinister (CTS) results when the left atrium is divided into two compartments by a membrane. The membrane can vary in size and shape and may have one or more openings. Severe cases of cor triatriatum sinister usually present in infancy and are often associated with other heart defects. In less severe cases, the diagnosis may not be made until later in life. The specific symptoms depend on the degree to which the membrane obstructs the flow of blood and whether or not there are additional heart defects. Symptoms may range from mild shortness of breath during exercise to signs of heart failure and lung congestion. Some people with CTS may not have symptoms. Treatment varies according to the severity of the symptoms. For symptomatic patients, surgery is generally consideredthe definitive course of therapy.

master.definition_en: A category of mesenchymal gynecologic neoplasms. It includes endometrial stromal nodule, endometrioid stromal sarcoma, and undifferentiated sarcoma. Endometrial stromal nodule has been described in the uterine corpus only. Histologically, it is characterized by the lack of infiltration of the surrounding tissues. Endometrioid stromal sarcoma affects the uterine corpus, and rarely, the ovaries, cervix, and vagina. In the uterine corpus it is classified as low grade or high grade endometrial stromal sarcoma. In the remainder of the anatomic sites it is classified as low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma. Undifferentiated sarcoma was previously also known as high grade endometrial stromal sarcoma. In 2014, high grade endometrial stromal sarcoma was reclassified and is currently considered a distinct and rare neoplasm that affects the uterine corpus only. It appears to have a prognosis that falls between low grade endometrial stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated sarcoma. The latter affects the uterine corpus and rarely the remainder of the anatomic sites.
